title: UneceLanguageProficiency
description:
Skills in any principal method of human communication, consisting of words used in a structured and conventional way and
conveyed by speech, writing, or gesture.

languageName.description: A name, expressed as text, of the language for which this language proficiency is defined.

personalLanguageProficiencyLanguageCode.description: The code specifying the language for this personal language proficiency.

personalLanguageProficiencyLanguageId.description: The identifier of the language for which this personal language proficiency is defined.

readingLevelCode.description: The code specifying the personal reading proficiency level in this language.

speakingLevelCode.description: The code specifying the personal speaking proficiency level in this language.

writingLevelCode.description: The code specifying the personal writing proficiency level in this language.
